blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A group composed of fisherfolk, buyers and intervenors on Wednesday called on the government to amend the Philippine Fisheries Code of 1998 by lifting the blanket prohibition on commercial fishing in municipal waters. This as the group—composed of more than 100 fishers, buyers and intervenors—pointed out in a manifesto submitted to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) that the fishing industry in the Philippines has already been left behind. In their manifesto, the group sought the lifting of the blanket prohibition on commercial fishing in municipal waters and the determination of fishing grounds based on scientific […]...
